description.value:
You learn a set of combat maneuvers powered by special superiority dice, drawn from the maneuvers list.

Maneuvers Known. You start with two maneuvers of your choice and learn more as you level, per the Maneuvers Known column of the Maverick Superiority table. Most maneuvers add an effect to an attack; you can only apply one maneuver per attack and each maneuver only once per turn. Whenever you learn new maneuvers, you may also swap out one maneuver you already know for a different one.

Superiority Dice. You have two superiority dice, starting as d4s; you gain more dice at higher levels per the Superiority Dice Quantity column, and the die itself grows larger per the Superiority Dice Size column. A die is spent when you use it, and you recover every spent die on finishing a short or long rest.

Maneuver Ability. The ability governing a maneuver depends on its type: your choice of Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution for physical maneuvers, your choice of Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma for mental maneuvers, and any ability you choose for general maneuvers. This ability applies whenever a maneuver references your maneuver ability, and it sets the save DC for maneuvers you use.

Maneuver save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your maneuver ability modifier
